# Adelphi Healthcare Packaging

> Adelphi Healthcare Packaging is a UK-based supplier of pharmaceutical containers, closures, and drug delivery systems serving pharma, biotech, and clinical trial markets for over 50 years.

Adelphi specializes in primary and secondary pharmaceutical packaging solutions including sterile vials, closures, syringes, and transfer devices. The company partners with leading manufacturers like SCHOTT Pharma, West Pharmaceutical Services, and ARaymondlife to deliver compliant, quality-assured packaging across multiple therapeutic areas including cell and gene therapy, radiopharmacy, and contract manufacturing.

## Key Topics

- Pharmaceutical packaging
- Sterile vials
- Drug delivery systems
- Closures and stoppers
- SCHOTT Pharma
- West Pharmaceutical
- Cell and gene therapy
- Clinical trials

- Regulatory compliance

- Transfer devices
- Radiopharmacy
- Veterinary pharmaceuticals

## Core Packaging Products

- [Pharmaceutical Containers](https://adelphi-hp.com/products/containers): Injection vials and syrup bottles designed for pharmaceutical industries
- [Pharmaceutical Closures](https://adelphi-hp.com/products/closures): Stoppers, crimp seals, and screw caps for vials ensuring product integrity
- [Drug Delivery Systems](https://adelphi-hp.com/products/drug-delivery-systems): Syringes, dropper bottles, pumps, and atomisers for therapeutic delivery
- [Sterile Drug Transfer Devices](https://adelphi-hp.com/products/transfer-devices): Safe medicine transfer solutions with needle-stick prevention features
- [Pharmacy Supplies](https://adelphi-hp.com/products/pharmacy-supplies): Plastic suppository moulds for pharmaceutical preparation

## Industries & Applications

- [Industries We Serve](https://adelphi-hp.com/our-industries): Pharma, biotech, cell & gene therapy, CMOs, and clinical trial packaging solutions
- [Pharmaceutical Packaging Supply](https://adelphi-hp.com/our-industries/pharmaceuticals): 50+ years of reliable, compliant vials and closures for pharmaceutical manufacturers
- [Cell and Gene Therapy Packaging](https://adelphi-hp.com/our-industries/cell-gene-therapy): Sterile vials designed for extreme storage conditions in advanced therapies
- [Clinical Trials Packaging](https://adelphi-hp.com/our-industries/clinical-trials): Flexible, compliant trial supply solutions for clinical development
- [CMOs & CDMOs Packaging](https://adelphi-hp.com/our-industries/contract-manufacturers): Sterile vials meeting time-sensitive quality demands for contract manufacturers
- [R&D Packaging Solutions](https://adelphi-hp.com/our-industries/research-development): Flexible packaging solutions from early-stage research to scale-up
- [Radiopharmacy Packaging Support](https://adelphi-hp.com/our-industries/radiopharmacy): Anoxos and Mix2Vial solutions for isotope formulations
- [Veterinary Pharmaceutical Packaging](https://adelphi-hp.com/our-industries/veterinary-medicines): Robust vials and bottles protecting veterinary medicine integrity

## Strategic Partners

- [Our Partners](https://adelphi-hp.com/partners): Distribution partnerships with SCHOTT Pharma, West, and ARaymondlife
- [SCHOTT Pharma Partnership](https://adelphi-hp.com/partners/schott-pharma): Glass containers, vials, cartridges, adaptiQ and EVERIC technology
- [West Pharmaceutical Partnership](https://adelphi-hp.com/partners/west): NovaPure and Crystal Zenith vial-closure components and sterile devices
- [ARaymondlife Partnership](https://adelphi-hp.com/partners/araymond-life): Exclusive distributor of RayDyLyo Push-fit Vial Caps for UK and Ireland
